Carlos de Anda, an aspirant for coordinator of Morena's municipal Defense of the Transformation in Nuevo Laredo, is calling for unity and respect among the aspirants in the party's internal process, according to NDL Noticias.

De Anda, an architect, spoke to reporters at the opening of a business in Nuevo Laredo, where he appeared as a special guest, according to the report.

He said he recently met with René Bejarano Martínez, leader of the Movimiento Nacional por la Esperanza, and that they discussed public works, actions and social programs under the governments of former President Andrés Manuel López Obrador and current President Claudia Sheinbaum, and the benefits those programs have brought residents, according to the report.

De Anda said he told Bejarano he has stepped away from his administrative post in the municipal government to register for the internal process, and that Bejarano wished him well and urged respect and unity among all registered aspirants, according to the report.

He also pointed to social programs for older adults, people with disabilities, single mothers and students, health actions, and a planned General Hospital project in Nuevo Laredo, with investment expected next year, according to the report.

Bejarano may visit Nuevo Laredo soon, depending on his schedule, to meet with movement leaders and greet Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal, according to the report.

Source: NDL Noticias, Nov. 17, 2026.

title: Carlos de Anda Calls for Unity in Morena's Nuevo Laredo Internal Race
